name: Coumarin 153
description: Abs ~423 / Em ~530 nm (EtOH). Classic solvation-dynamics probe.

name: BODIPY core
description: 4,4-Difluoro-4-bora-3a,4a-diaza-s-indacene. Abs ~497 / Em ~505 nm; very narrow bands.

name: Nile Red
description: Solvatochromic lipid stain. Em ~550-650 nm depending on environment.

name: DAPI
description: Blue DNA stain (minor groove). Abs ~358 / Em ~461 nm when bound.

name: Hoechst 33258
description: Cell-permeant blue DNA stain. Abs ~352 / Em ~461 nm.

name: Ethidium
description: Intercalating DNA stain. Em ~605 nm, ~20x brighter when bound.

name: Quinine
description: Fluorescence quantum-yield standard (in 0.5 M H2SO4). Abs ~350 / Em ~450 nm.
